description: Replace torch.geqrf for small and medium square batches with a CUDA C++ extension implementing batched Householder QR in-place, targeting n<=512 with one matrix per block/CTA family and falling back to torch.geqrf for larger or numerically risky cases.

Implement a CUDA C++ tiled panel-factorization path for the dominant 640x512 benchmark cases, using shared-memory column reductions and FP32 Householder updates across each matrix while preserving torch.geqrf compact outputs and falling back on unsupported stress shapes.

Reduce Python and launch overhead around the existing torch.geqrf baseline by adding shape-specialized dispatch, caching, preallocation, and avoiding redundant clones or synchronizations without changing numerical semantics.

Extend the winning n=32 CUDA C++ Householder path to n=176 and n=352 with shape-specific kernels using CTA-level reductions, explicit routing benchmarks, and hard fallback for n>=512 or stress cases when the custom route is not faster.

Preserve eight-stream 80-matrix geqrf batching for 640x512, graft the n==32 warp-specialized CUDA QR fast path, resolve dispatch ordering so shape predicates are disjoint, keep existing fallbacks, and benchmark each active shape to disable any regressing route.

Add a separate guarded stream-chunked path for batch=60,n=1024 normal, mixed, and nearrank QR, sweep chunk and stream shapes 4/8/12/15/20/30, keep the existing 32-stream batch=640,n=512 route unchanged, and disable any 1024 variant that regresses.

Preserve the 32-stream 640x512 geqrf fast path, graft the n==176 128-thread fixed-CUDA route and n==32 warp route if missing, centralize non-overlapping shape predicates, benchmark all active shapes, and disable any grafted path that regresses.

Preserve the 32-stream 640x512 and guarded 12-chunk 60x1024 fast paths, graft only the n==32 warp-CUDA and fixed n==176 CUDA routes behind centralized exact predicates, benchmark every active QR shape, and disable any graft that regresses the 46.07ms parent metric.

Target remaining large QR shapes batch=8,n=2048 and batch=2,n=4096 with guarded stream-chunked or batched large-shape routes, sweep chunk counts, stream counts, and row/column partitioning, preserve existing 640x512 and 60x1024 fast paths byte-for-byte, profile first, and keep only non-regressing correct routes.

Preserve winner stream and chunk routes for n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096, graft only exact n==32 warp CUDA and n==176 fixed CUDA fast paths behind centralized non-overlapping predicates, benchmark all active shapes, and disable any graft causing regression.

Target batch=40,n=352 and n=176 medium QR gaps with guarded stream-chunked torch.geqrf or compact custom CUDA dispatch, sweep stream and chunk counts, preserve existing n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096 fast routes, benchmark active shapes, and keep only non-regressing wins.

Preserve all stream routes for n=176, n=352, n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096 from the medium-shape leader, graft only the exact n==32 warp CUDA path behind an exact predicate, do not replace n=176 unless measured faster, benchmark every active shape, and revert any regression.

Reduce tiny-shape overhead without new CUDA by optimizing n=32 Python dispatch, predicate order, exact stream/geqrf path selection, and avoiding torch.cat/split/chunk work on small paths; preserve existing n=176, n=352, n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096 stream routes and benchmark all active shapes.

Preserve exact n==32 warp CUDA and coordinate-descent tune only guarded stream chunk counts for n176/n352={7,8,9}, n512={24,28,32,36}, n1024={10,12,14}, n2048={6,8,10}, and n4096={1,2}; benchmark all active shapes after accepted changes and keep only a non-regressing total-metric combination.

Explore a hybrid blocked TSQR/Householder route for large active regimes by factoring panels with small CUDA kernels and applying block reflectors via GEMM-like trailing updates, route only by matrix size, keep the current n32 CUDA and stream-chunk path as fallback, and target lower global-memory traffic on 2048/4096-scale cases.

Reduce stream-chunked output assembly overhead by replacing torch.cat/list aggregation with preallocated H/tau outputs plus slice copies or out buffers where safe, preserving n32 CUDA and exact current chunk routes and counts, benchmarking all active shapes, and keeping only non-regressing variants.

Cherry-pick only the preallocated output-assembly idea onto the tuned chunk-count parent, preserving n512=28, n1024=10, all other current chunk counts, and the n32 CUDA path. Benchmark parent and candidate across all active shapes in the same run, keeping the assembly change only if the primary metric improves, otherwise revert cleanly.

Coordinate-descent tuned shape chunks around the out= assembly leader, preserving n32 CUDA and stream torch.geqrf out= slice assembly; test one-axis-at-a-time n176/n352={7,8,9}, n512={26,28,30}, n1024={9,10,11}, n2048={7,8,9}, n4096={2,3,4}, benchmark all active shapes, and keep only total-metric non-regressions.

Preserve global-best out= slice assembly and all tuned routes, graft only the n4096 chunk=4 route from the large-shape branch, benchmark same-run against n4096 chunk=2 under out= assembly, and keep it only if it improves the primary metric.

Preserve all stream out= routes from the parent and focus only on exact batch=20,n=32: specialize the existing qr32 CUDA path for small batch by reducing launch geometry or warps, optionally adding a batch20-specific kernel that avoids idle warps and improves tau/H writes, benchmark all active shapes, and keep only total-metric non-regressions.

Micro-optimize Python stream orchestration only: specialize or hoist per-shape stream lists and route metadata to reduce launch-helper overhead while preserving out= assembly, n32 CUDA, and all chunk counts; benchmark all active shapes and keep only non-regressions.

Micro-optimize only the n32 one-warp path: try leaner half-warp or fewer-thread variants, possible two-matrices-per-block batching, and reduced shared-memory or tau traffic while preserving all existing stream and size routes; validate and benchmark all active QR_v2 shapes, keeping only total-metric non-regressions.

Preserve one-warp n32 CUDA and out= stream routing and assembly exactly, graft only n512=30 and n1024=9 chunk counts from the tuning branch, then same-run benchmark against parent and keep only on primary metric improvement.

Optimize batch=20,n=32 compact geqrf path by fully specializing the existing one-warp Householder kernel for n=32: unroll reflector generation and application, keep R/tau in registers or shared memory, remove dynamic loops/branches and redundant global traffic, preserve torch.geqrf packed output/tau exactly, and avoid stream/out route or chunk-size tuning.

Graft only the fully unrolled one-warp n32 CUDA kernel onto the current best, preserving n512=30, n1024=9, out= assembly, and all existing routes; same-run benchmark against parent and keep only if the primary metric improves.
